title: [$175] Ecard - The empty illustration is not shown after removing user admin permission
body:

To join our Slack channel, fill out [this form](https://forms.gle/Q7hnhUJPnQCK7Fe56). ___ **Version Number:** v9.5.0-0 **Reproducible in staging?:** Yes **Reproducible in production?:** Yes **If this was caught during regression testing, add the test name, ID and link from BrowserStack:** https://github.com/Expensify/App/pull/100667 **Email or phone of affected tester (no customers):** applausetester+bg098oo@applause.expensifail.com **Issue reported by:** Applause Internal Team **Bug source:** Pull Request QA execution **Device used:** macOS/chrome **App Component:** Other ## Action Performed: Precondition. User A: Has Workspace with Expensify Card configured on it. User A: Add user B as admin member Steps: As User B 1. Create a workspace whose currency is not USD, GBP or EUR 2. Enable the Expensify Card feature 3. Go to workspace > Expensify Card > View Card > Select Workspace As User A: 1. Remove user B's admin permission on workspace that has the Expensify Card configured on it. ## Expected Result: User B see the empty illustration after admin permission removed ## Actual Result: User B workspace still has access to Expensify Card ## Workaround: Unknown ## Platforms: - [x] Android: App - [ ] Android: mWeb Chrome - [x] iOS: App - [ ] iOS: mWeb Safari - [ ] iOS: mWeb Chrome - [x] Windows: Chrome - [x] MacOS: Chrome Safari ## Screenshots/Videos https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/235d8c7f-48dd-4075-9251-7d6bc95e4407 [View all open jobs on GitHub](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%22Help+Wanted%22) > **Applause Internal Information** > Exported by: Julia Ponikarchuk > Bug ID: 7274007
